## What's free

Little Lemur RabbitMQ: 1M messages/month, 20 connections, 100 queues

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://www.cloudamqp.com/plans.html> before relying on this.

## Plan

- `modules/<service>`: the managed resources, sized to the free tier by default
- `stack/`: the root module whose outputs expose connection details (sensitive values marked `sensitive`)
